name: The Dragon Princess
source:
On the night before her wedding, Princess Amaia of Steinna whispers a wish she thinks will be unheard. The moment she pronounces thse words, "I don't want to marry him", a dragon appears and, in a pure fairy tale fashion, kidnaps the Princess, trapping her in a tower.

Surprisingly enough, the dragon, named Happho, is rather sympathetic and claims she wants to set Amaia free from her tyrannic fiancé, Azaiah, of whom the Princess of Steinna seems frightened... 

Can Amaia really trust her jailor? And in the end, who will save the Princess?

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-dragon-princess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
婚礼前一天晚上，斯坦纳公主阿玛雅低声许下了一个她认为无人能听到的愿望。当她说出“我不想嫁给他”这句话时，一条龙出现了，并以纯粹童话般的方式绑架了公主，将她困在塔中。

令人惊讶的是，这条名叫哈福的龙颇有同情心，并声称她想让阿玛亚摆脱她残暴的未婚夫阿扎亚的束缚，而斯坦纳公主似乎很害怕阿扎亚…… 

阿玛亚真的可以信任她的狱卒吗？最后，谁能拯救公主呢？

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/the-dragon-princess]itch.io[/url]]
